spans.text: Results-driven Senior Network Engineer with 7+ years of progressive experience designing, securing, and optimizing
enterprise-grade networks across data centers, banking, and government sectors. Deep expertise in routing protocols
(BGP, OSPF), advanced switching (VLAN, VXLAN), next-generation firewall management (FortiGate, Palo Alto), and
cloud security (Netskope, Cloudflare). Demonstrated success maintaining 99.9% uptime for mission-critical WANs,
leading complex network migrations, and delivering scalable, secure infrastructure aligned with business objectives.
Currently extending cloud and security expertise with AWS, Terraform, and SASE technologies.
✦ Palo Alto / FortiGate / Panorama ✦ AWS Cloud Infrastructure
✦ Cisco / Juniper / Huawei Devices ✦ Vulnerability Assessment
Joined as Senior Network Engineer contributing to enterprise network architecture and security strategy.
Leveraging advanced expertise in Palo Alto firewalls, Netskope SASE, Cloudflare, and AWS cloud networking.
Implementing Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform for network automation and deployment pipelines.
Designing and enforcing Zero Trust network access policies across cloud and on-premise environments.

Switching & Overlay: VLAN, VXLAN, STP/RSTP, EtherChannel
